summary: Testing is implemented as validator behavior tests plus executable repository-contract validation, matching ArchitectPlaybook’s Markdown skill corpus instead of pretending it is an app framework project.

checks.expectation: Skill contracts and README index are executable tests.
checks.evidence: scripts/validate-playbook.py scans all top-level SKILL.md files and README links.
checks.remediation: Keep validator checks close to CLAUDE.md rules.

checks.expectation: Worktrees are a flag on each audit, not a standalone slash command.
checks.evidence: Validator fails if worktree/SKILL.md exists or audit Usage omits /<audit> --worktree.
checks.remediation: Leave standalone worktree helpers out unless the architecture docs change first.

checks.expectation: README bootstrap claim matches committed files.
checks.evidence: .claude/skills/install-architect-playbook-globally/SKILL.md is committed and validator checks it.
checks.remediation: Keep bootstrap installer synchronized with the root installer skill.

checks.expectation: Validator behavior has direct tests and CI runs them.
checks.evidence: tests/test_validate_playbook.py covers frontmatter parsing, valid repository acceptance, missing sections, standalone worktree rejection, hidden --target rejection, code-fence link ignoring, and current-repository CLI acceptance.

checks.expectation: Local hook installation does not silently destroy contributor hooks and works from linked worktrees.
checks.evidence: scripts/install-git-hooks.py resolves hooks with git rev-parse --git-path hooks, refuses to overwrite different existing hooks unless --force is passed, and writes a .architect-playbook-backup copy before replacement.
checks.remediation: Run python3 scripts/install-git-hooks.py; use --force only after reviewing existing hooks.
